description:
Your Jurism library is pre-populated with 10 legal references including US Supreme Court cases. Your task is to visually prioritize specific cases using colored tags.

1. Create a new tag named exactly "Landmark Decision" (case-sensitive).
2. Assign a display color to this tag (right-click the tag in the tag selector -> Assign Color).
3. Apply this "Landmark Decision" tag to exactly these three cases:
   - Brown v. Board of Education
   - Miranda v. Arizona
   - Gideon v. Wainwright

Do not apply this tag to any other items.
